name: Bitbucket Pipelines

modes.label: Atlassian cloud runners 1x/2x
modes.note: CI runner. Added 2026-09-28 (missing-providers audit). https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/docs/step-options/: 1x 2 CPU/4 GB/64 GB, 2x 4/8/64; an Nx step uses N x build minutes. https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket/pricing: extra minutes $10 per 1,000 => $0.60/h per 1x. Per-minute rounding assumed. (Docs text also says the default step has "4 CPUs (might be shared)"; the table says 1x = 2 CPU.)

modes.label: Atlassian cloud runners 4x..32x (paid plans)
modes.note: CI runner. Added 2026-09-28 (missing-providers audit). https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/docs/step-options/: 4x 8/16, 8x 16/32, 16x 32/64, 24x 48/96, 32x 64/128 (dedicated CPUs, 256 GB); only on paid plans (Standard/Premium). N x build minutes at $0.01/min.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: 50 build minutes/month, up to 5 users, max 10 concurrent steps. Overage NOT available (hard cap at 50 min); 1 GB workspace storage.

perf_source: No benchmark row: provider is not in ComputeSDK results or the HPC run (as of 2026-09-28). See research/perf-map.json.
caveats: Included minutes are build minutes (already multiplied by size), so included_usd = minutes x $0.01 applies to every size.
Extra minutes sold as $10 per 1,000-minute packs (monthly).
Step max runtime and concurrency limits not encoded.
Region for Atlassian cloud runners not verified (set us).

From Oct 26, 2026 (monthly plans) build-minute allowances are pooled at the Atlassian organization level instead of per workspace; from Dec 3, 2026 annual plans (previously NOT billed for minutes beyond plan limits) are billed for overage at published rates. Prepaid annual usage packs at a lower (sales-quoted) rate exist; 'committed packs' coming soon.

Self-hosted runners do not consume build minutes; Premium self-hosted runners (v5+) are licensed at $15/month per concurrent build slot (Standard includes 1 slot, Premium 2); a free tier of up to 100 self-hosted runners remains. BYO compute, not priced by the engine.
Agentic Pipelines (beta): AI-agent steps consume normal build minutes; LLM tokens billed by the LLM provider or as Rovo Dev credits.

Build minutes exclude runner-acquisition time (billed while status is 'In progress'); build minutes = wall minutes x size multiplier. Exact rounding (per-minute per step) is not stated on any official page.
Docker-in-step runs as a 'docker' service limited to 1 GB memory by default (memory is shared with the step); Pipelines only support IPv4.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.note: Steps are ephemeral CI containers bounded by max-time; state carries over only via explicit caches (dependency dirs) and artifacts. No snapshot concept in docs.

snapshot_on_demand.note: No snapshot/checkpoint API; caches and artifacts are the only persistence mechanisms (step-options page).

harness_api.quote: Bitbucket Pipelines supports integrating agents using either Rovo Dev (Atlassian-managed) or Codex or Claude Code (bring-your-own account).
harness_api.note: Agentic Pipelines (beta): agents defined in bitbucket-pipelines.yml (provider rovodev|claude|codex + prompt), run via `- agent: <name>` in a step; Pipelines installs the agent CLI, injects a Bitbucket MCP server and system prompt, and runs it 'non-interactively'. Started by push/PR triggers, UI or the pipelines REST API (prompts can be overridden by custom pipeline variables); output lands in step logs/artifacts. One-shot only: no follow-ups, no conversation listing/resume; one agent per step; not on self-hosted runners.

ingress_rules.note: Build steps expose no inbound ports/URLs at all on Atlassian cloud runners, so there is nothing to control (no preview URLs, no SSH-to-step).

secret_proxy.quote: Variables are accessed as environment variables in the build container:
secret_proxy.note: Secured variables are env vars masked in logs; third-party secret providers (Vault, AWS/Azure/GCP) fetch secrets at runtime into the step. Agent keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN, Rovo USER_API_TOKEN) are also passed as secure env vars. Step gets a scoped short-lived OAuth token; OIDC for cloud deploys.

volume_attach.quote: artifacts — to retain artifacts that subsequent steps can consume.
volume_attach.note: No volumes; only caches and artifacts. Fixed disk per size (64 GB default at 1x/2x). Docker volume mapping outside $BITBUCKET_CLONE_DIR is restricted on runtime v2.

volume_shared.note: No shared filesystem between concurrent steps; artifacts pass files between sequential steps only.
